verdict.rationale: Salv documents real-time payment screening that returns a decision in the API response while the payment is still in flight, so the client system can hold it before release. Inspecting the supporting matches is only implied, through name-match adjudication with explained reasoning and through alerts, not shown as a documented view of the decision's match details. missing for 10: documented inspection of the decision's matched list entries and scores, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches

citations.quote: Payments are screened in real time: your system makes the call and gets the decision back in the response, while the payment is still in flight.
Real-time returns an answer inside the API response, so your system can hold the payment
AI-Powered Insights adjudicates a name match and explains its reasoning
